title: "Candidate for District Court Judge: Dan B. Johnson" (Drew Lawson, Jul 14, 2022)
notes: Public preview: Johnson, 67 in 2022, Minneapolis native, appointed July 1, 2015 and re-elected twice unopposed; 42 years in law including Stevens County deputy prosecutor and private practice in Spokane; eight years before mandatory retirement.
